title: Time-lapse Killing Assay for Spheroids Using IncuCyte
author: Philippa R Kennedy
materials: Image analysis is performed in the IncuCyte software. The size of each spheroid, as detected by edge analysis of the transmitted light image or fluorescence detection of the spheroid mass, is measured for each time point and normalized to the size of the spheroid at the time effectors and drugs were added (t = 0 h).

steps.title: Prepare and seed target cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend target cells in preferred media and seed 2x10^4 cells in 100 μL/well into a 96 well U-bottom low adhesion plate (ULA plate, Cat. No. 7007, Corning).

steps.title: Centrifuge to form pellets
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the plate to ensure a centered pellet, repeating the process to prevent skewing.

substeps.instruction: Spin the plate at 200 g (1000 RPM) with acceleration 6 and brake 0.
Allow the plate to come to a gentle stop (~10 min).
Rotate the plate 180° in the horizontal plane and repeat the centrifugation procedure.

steps.title: Verify pellet position
steps.instruction: Capture an image of the plate using the live-cell image system (Incucyte S3 or Zoom) to verify cells are in the center of the well.

substeps.instruction: If cells are at edges, contain large gaps, or are too condensed, resuspend with a multichannel pipette and repeat seeding/centrifugation until a central single-layered pellet is achieved.

steps.title: Add effector cells and treatments
steps.instruction: After allowing spheroids to form for 1-5 days, add effector cells and treatments slowly and precisely on top of the spheroids.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the total well volume reaches 200 μL.

steps.title: Perform time-lapse imaging
steps.instruction: Place the plate back into the live-cell image system and capture images of the wells at regular intervals for 5 days.
